subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: After the reported path is reproduced, should OpenClaw align live/display/Codex transcript caps with `toolResultMaxChars`, or keep separate fixed budgets for display and persisted transcript surfaces?
rationale: Current source shows several distinct caps that protect different surfaces; changing them without maintainer intent can affect session retention, user-visible display, and safety defaults.

options.title: Reproduce Before Choosing Caps
options.body: First capture packaged gateway evidence for the exact failing surface, then decide the smallest cap or persistence fix for that surface.

options.title: Align Caps To Config
options.body: Treat `toolResultMaxChars` as the canonical cap for relevant model-visible and transcript paths once upgrade behavior is accepted.

options.title: Keep Separate Budgets
options.body: Preserve fixed display/transcript budgets and only fix a demonstrated persistence or projection bug within those separate contracts.

recommendation.title: Reproduce Before Choosing Caps
recommendation.body: First capture packaged gateway evidence for the exact failing surface, then decide the smallest cap or persistence fix for that surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to recent tool-result truncation and projection behavior among the likely owners.
